$comment: What a use case can need, mapped to the feature catalog. Every capability belongs to one product, names the catalog features that teach it (the lab topics), and says in one clause why it points to that product. The generator derives knowledge, tools, product fit, level, and Learn links from these entries, so a use case can only claim what the catalog knows. A capability with forcesCopilotStudio true has no Agent Builder equivalent in the catalog (Learn's decision guide: external channels, external-service actions or workflows, and environments), so a use case that needs it is a Copilot Studio use case. Templates use {docs}, {data}, {topic}, {work}, {who} from the industry and department context.
